instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Peter listens to music every day for three hours. Marcia listens to 15% less music, while Matilda listens to 20% more music than Peter. Who spends the most time listening to music?

Matilda’s school did a survey among all students to find out how much time they spend playing an instrument each day. According to the survey, <mat>3/4</mat> of all students play an instrument, but only <mat>4/20</mat> play on a daily basis. What percentage of the students play an instrument daily?

Although 75% of all students play an instrument once a week, only 20% of those students play an instrument on a daily basis. Which decimal represents how many students do not play an instrument at all?

Besides music, Matilda’s school also has three dance programmes: hip-hop, ballet and salsa. The most popular class is ballet with a participation rate of 0.6, followed by hip-hop with 0.25 of the students. If taking part in one of the programmes is compulsory, what percentage of students participate in the salsa classes?

After school, Matilda likes to go shopping with her best friend. Usually, she spends about <mat>21/25</mat> of her pocket money on books. What percentage of her pocket money does Matilda spend on books?
Marcia rather spends her pocket money on computer games. Since computer games are very expensive, she saves <mat>4/5</mat> of her money every month. What is <mat>4/5</mat> as a decimal?
Matilda is confused about how much Marcia spends on computer games. What is 0.8 as a percentage?
Given that Marcia spends <mat>80%</mat> of her pocket money on computer games, what fraction of her money does she have left?

Later that day, Marcia and Matilda meet up with Peter for dinner. They order a bean stew which is made up of <mat>30%</mat> tomatoes, 50% beans, <mat>15%</mat> onions and <mat>5%</mat> herbs. Select all correct decimals for the listed ingredients.
